figures.finding: FINAS's Film in Malaysia Incentive pays a 30% cash rebate on qualifying Malaysian production and post-production expenditure (QMPE), plus up to 5% more for projects passing the Cultural Test; a domestic production must spend at least RM1 million of QMPE, and only the first RM7.5 million of any one person's salary counts.

value.base: Qualifying Malaysian Production Expenditure (production and post-production in Malaysia)

figures.applies: Malaysia, domestic productions (film, TV, screen-based content) under the 2025 guidelines.

sources.said: Cash Rebate Means the 30% cash rebate which shall be based on the total amount of QMPE for production and post-production activities in Malaysia … Means the additional cash rebate of up to 5% which shall be subject to the passing of the Cultural Test for production activities only in Malaysia. … (a) spend QMPE with a minimum of Malaysian Ringgit One Million (MYR1,000,000.00) in aggregate for production work only in order to be entitled to Cash Rebate; … the cash rebate of FIMI is only claimable on the first Malaysian Ringgit Seven Million and Five Hundred Thousand (MYR7,500,000.00) of any one person’s salary (cast and/or crew) for services rendered in Malaysia.

sources.title: Film in Malaysia Incentive (FIMI) Guidelines (Domestic Production), National Film Development Corporation Malaysia (FINAS), 2025
